Name: Persistent Tents
Author: Tiare151
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Persistent Tents is a simple mod that changes how tents behave in Stardew Valley. Tents will no longer disappear automatically and cannot be destroyed by NPCs walking through them. Players can still remove tents normally with a pickaxe.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and extract this mod.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the mod folder into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] [/color]folder.[/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.
[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/*]
[*]Tents no longer disappear automatically.[/*]
[*]NPCs cannot trample or destroy tents.[/*]
[*]Players can still remove tents with a pickaxe.[/*]
[*]Lightweight and simple — no configuration required.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI[/color]


[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]me and GPT[/color][/*]
